THE PROBLEM

Security assessments are still manual work

A security researcher personally identifies targets, performs reconnaissance, runs scanners, reads raw tool output, correlates results across tools, researches vulnerabilities, removes false positives, validates important findings, writes remediation and assembles the final report.

✦FragmentedEvery tool ships its own output format.
↻RepetitiveThe same pipeline is re-run on every assessment.
◔Time-consumingHours lost to parsing, correlating, writing.
✦Hard to correlateFindings across assets stay disconnected.
⊘Blind trustScanner output too often taken at face value.
The reality today — a dozen tools, one overwhelmed researcher
One researcher. A dozen tools. Ten manual steps between a raw scan and a usable report.
OUR SOLUTION

Meet Hackerster

An AI-assisted cybersecurity assessment platform that automates and organizes authorized security testing — coordinating specialized AI agents, real security tools, vulnerability knowledge and human approval from start to finish.

01DiscoverMap hosts, services and technologies.
02EnumerateDrill into ports, endpoints and exposure.
03AnalyzeCorrelate findings with vulnerability knowledge via RAG.
04ValidateVerify evidence before calling anything a vulnerability.
05ReportExecutive-ready output in four formats.

KEY INNOVATION — MODEL AGNOSTIC

The agent is separated from the model

Hackerster is not tied to one AI provider. Agents run on local .gguf models, Ollama or API-based cloud providers — and every agent's model is configured independently.

▦ Local .gguf model

  • Local inference — data never leaves the machine
  • Better privacy, works offline
  • No mandatory external API
  • Task-fit model for each agent

☁ API-based model

  • Access to more powerful cloud models
  • Any provider, any model
  • No local hardware ceiling
  • Choose by capability and speed
"Hackerster separates the AI agent from the AI model, allowing each agent to independently use a local GGUF model or an API-based model according to the user's hardware, privacy, cost and performance requirements."

TOOL ORCHESTRATION

SAFETY & HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP

The researcher stays in control

Hackerster never lets the AI blindly execute arbitrary actions. Every action carries a risk level, and higher-risk operations require explicit human approval.
